svg.title: Indeed the clock estimate gives Ak(c) ≤bβ1/2 k eventually, while β−1 k ≤2 bβ−1 k . Their product is at most 2 bβ−1/2 k →0. Let Pk be the real orbit projection of the principal degree-five logarithmic insertion, and Ek the corresponding orbit projection of the degree-five divergence insertion associated with the un- corrected stress. They are expressed in the same transported coordinate chart and use the same extracted coupling. Define vk = β−1 k Pk −Ek. (TS2)
